# Method seed class bridges

This owned hierarchy retains one independently named Object method formal and
two boolean inputs at each covariant override. A closed generic base and marker
remain distinct from those method scopes. The original middle and leaf methods
call super, perform their original checked casts, and return the actual value.

Four frozen caller routes run 128 fresh cases twice through typed, middle and
base slots and a future subclass override. They check input and receiver identity,
primitive values, callbacks, partial effects, both original result-cast positions,
opaque or aliased results, nulls and exact checked/runtime/error identity. Thirteen
wrong programs and eight same-Code Signature controls qualify the observations.

Source and SDK profiles compile every emitted unit and compare every original
definition, method role, Signature and Exceptions entry. Original compiler bridge
identities, targets and ancestor slots are exact; their reported source-projection
status remains unchanged. All inputs and names are independently owned examples.
